meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: Claude 会用 dial 命令行操作一个已配好的真实电话号码:发短信、发起由 AI 语音代理接听的电话、等待并读取对方发来的消息或验证码,还能查看和设置号码的接听行为。所有命令支持 --json 机器可读输出。
howto.when: 当用户提到电话、短信、验证码等关键词,或要求给某人发短信、打电话、等待验证码时触发;本会话首次运行 dial 命令前也应先加载。

say.text: 用 dial 给 +14155550123 发条短信:会议改到三点
say.note: 通过 dial message 发送 SMS

say.text: 帮我打给 +14155550123,问一下明天的预约时间
say.note: 发起 AI 语音通话,结束后取回结果

say.text: 等对方发来的短信验证码,收到就告诉我

howto.what_en: Claude uses the dial CLI to work an already-provisioned real phone number: send SMS, place AI voice calls, and wait for inbound messages or verification codes, plus view and set number behavior. Every command supports --json output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions phones, texts, SMS, OTP or verification codes, or asks to text, call, or wait for a code; also load it before the first dial command in a session.

say_en.text: Text +14155550123 via dial: meeting moved to 3pm
say_en.note: Sends the SMS with dial message

say_en.text: Call +14155550123 and ask about tomorrow's appointment
say_en.note: Places an AI voice call, then fetches the result

say_en.text: Wait for their SMS code and tell me when it arrives
